transactions.input: how has brazilian coffee export volumes changed this year?

agent_response.message: Brazilian coffee export volumes have changed this year, with a decrease of 2.4 percent in the 2025/26 harvest, resulting in a forecasted export of 40.75 million 60-kg bags. This decline is attributed to Brazil's record export volumes in 2024, reduced coffee crop availability, and increased tariffs. In terms of revenue, despite the decrease in export volume, shipments generated US$ 14,728 billion, a 50 percent increase over the previous record, marking Brazil's highest coffee export value in history. Additionally, in September 2025, Brazil exported 3.750 million 60-kg bags of coffee, an 18 percent decrease from the same month in 2024, while foreign exchange revenue rose by 11 percent during the same period, totaling US$ 1.369 billion.
